**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The ownership stack sits at (not merely near) our preferred position:

- **§14.1 / §15.1 — Customer Data and Customer IP:** We own all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information, Customer-provided material and independently developed IP; Vendor gets only a limited processing right, with §15.1 barring sale, advertising use, commingling and model training without our written consent. No assignment to Vendor anywhere.
- **§14.2 — Deliverables:** Ownership vests in us on creation, with an express Vendor assignment of worldwide right, title and interest, equivalent personnel assignments, and further-assurance cooperation.
- **§14.3 + §13.2 — Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables:** Vendor retains only its pre-existing Vendor Technology (acceptable), and any embedded Vendor Technology carries the §13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify and create derivative works for our business — plus a duty to flag material Vendor Technology and not to embed restrictive third-party material.
- **§14.4 — Joint ownership:** Excluded unless separately signed, and our feedback rights remain unrestricted.

Noted but not flagged (minor sub-elements per playbook): Deliverable ownership is conditioned on payment of Fees, and §13.2 permits contractor support rather than using the word "sublicense."
